## 1. Build, Lint, Test and Coverage

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `vite build` | build production bundle (IIFE widget, `dist/`) |
| `npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration` | run full test suite (vitest unit + playwright integration) |
| `eslint .` | lint all JS files |
| none found | coverage reporters (`text`, `html`) configured in `vitest.config.js`, no npm script wires them up |

## 2. Code Style & Project Conventions

- ESLint flat config, `@eslint/js` recommended ruleset — `eslint.config.js`.
- ECMAScript target 2020, ES module source type (`ecmaVersion: 2020`, `sourceType: 'module'`) — `eslint.config.js`.
- `package.json` sets `"type": "module"` — repo-wide ESM syntax.
- Lint ignores `node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `coverage/`, `playwright-report/`, `test-results/` — `eslint.config.js`.
- Browser globals allowed: `window`, `document`, `URL`, `URLSearchParams`, `AbortController`, `setTimeout`, `clearTimeout`, `console`, `process` — `eslint.config.js`.
- JavaScript ES2020 / HTML5 / CSS3: follow standard conventions (seeded from pre-existing AGENTS.md).
- No runtime dependencies (`dependencies.runtime` is empty) — widget ships dependency-free by design.
- Source split by responsibility: `src/core/` (business logic), `src/ui/` (DOM rendering), `src/integrations/` (GTM + webhook clients), `src/config.js` (defaults/factory), `src/index.js` (entrypoint).

Full conventions: [docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md](docs/agents/coding_guidelines.md).

## 3. Agent Communication & Behavioral Guidelines

- Keep `src/` changes scoped to their responsibility folder (`core/`, `ui/`, `integrations/`) — do not mix DOM code into `core/`.
- Run `npm test` and `npm run lint` before proposing a change complete (seeded from pre-existing AGENTS.md).
- Report webhook/GTM behavior changes explicitly — both are external integration points (`src/integrations/webhook.js`, `src/integrations/gtm.js`).

### Never in this repository

- Never leave ESLint errors unresolved — `eslint .` must pass clean against `js.configs.recommended` (`eslint.config.js`).
- Never add a runtime dependency casually — `dependencies.runtime` is empty; the widget is built and shipped as a dependency-free IIFE bundle.

## 4. Setup, Troubleshooting and Tips

Prereqs: Node.js + npm (package-lock.json present, no other package manager referenced).

```sh
npm install
npm run dev          # Vite dev server (127.0.0.1)
npm test             # unit + integration tests
npm run lint         # eslint .
npm run build        # dist/ bundle via vite build
```

Deploy (Cloudflare Pages/Workers, `wrangler.jsonc`):

```sh
npm run deploy        # build + wrangler deploy
npm run preview        # build + wrangler dev
```

Tips:
- Widget POSTs leads to an externally configured `webhookUrl` (`src/integrations/webhook.js`) — not a repo-owned API; point it at your own endpoint during local testing.
- Product-trigger snippet (`src/snippet.html`) needs `data-product-name`/`data-product-id`; missing either falls back to the global manual-subject flow (README).
- `webhookTimeoutMs` config controls the fallback wait before the widget proceeds without webhook confirmation.
- GTM event names (`openEventName`, `completeEventName`) default to `wpp_qualificacao_inicio` / `wpp_qualificacao_concluida`, pushed to `window.dataLayer` (README).
